title: B-tree new-database initialization entry

scope.rationale: sqlite3BtreeNewDb serializes the B-tree, forces the shared page count to zero, invokes newDatabase, and returns its exact result.

external_source_responsibilities: initializeDatabase implements source newDatabase header/page construction
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete entry wrapper and delegated new-database initializer are assigned in the production B-tree owner.

inputs: Mutable B-tree with page one available
contracts.ownership: B-tree and page one remain owned by Shared.
contracts.state_and_results: Resets database_pages to zero before delegation. Successful initialization publishes one-page database header state.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Source enters/leaves B-tree mutex. Zig caller owns equivalent serialization; delegated initialization mutates page one.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Missing/short page one errors propagate after database_pages has been reset, matching entry ordering.

representation_differences: Zig returns an error union instead of SQLite result integer and relies on caller-held serialization rather than entering a stored mutex.

oracle.protocol: Start with zeroed page one and nonzero database_pages, invoke entry, observe one-page header magic/root marker and resulting count one.
oracle.normalization: Zig success/error maps to SQLite result code.

assurance.oom: No allocation in entry; delegated page owner is pre-existing.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: Bounded owner mutates memory page; Pager-write and mutex integration remain pending.
assurance.malformed_input: Missing/short page one returns explicit error.
assurance.continuation: Successful database is immediately available to B-tree operations.

integration.native_call_path: initializeNewDatabase delegates to initializeDatabase and publishes shared.database_pages/page-one state consumed by pageCount and transactions.

independent_review.notes: Requires Pager-write/mutex trace, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Integrate source Pager-write result and B-tree serialization around the entry.

implementation_spans: upstream/sqlite/src/btree.c:3470-3562 including unlockBtreeIfUnused, newDatabase, and sqlite3BtreeNewDb were reviewed
src/core/internal/btree_core.zig initializeDatabase, page-one ownership, page count, transactions, and tests were reviewed
callees: newDatabase and sqlite3PagerWrite in the source
assertions_branches_cleanup: The generated return block is assigned
No allocation or cleanup in the entry wrapper
upstream_tests: Upstream B-tree newdb, empty database, page-size, auto-vacuum, OOM, and I/O tests exercise this entry
Project B-tree differential exercises database header/page ownership
